implemented: Markdown live preview now renders headings, tasks, lists, tables, callouts, fenced code and highlights through text-only DOM construction; footnotes, math, diagrams and raw HTML are visibly labeled without execution or source rewriting.

Graph metadata distinguishes notes, attachments and unresolved targets and derives folder groups; Canvas and Bases fixtures cover source-preserving unknown fields and supported view/node types.
